lines.t: The call goes out across the sky, so whisper turns to thunderous cries
Hearts awaken, eyes behold, the promise spoken long foretold
The veil is breaking, light pours through
Every word now proven true
We are rising, rising high
Lifted up beyond the sky
Every tear now wiped away
As night gives birth to endless days
Gathering up the trumpet sound
In peace and glory we are found
In woman's glory we are found
The world once dimmed in shadows
Now shines beneath the holy blaze
Names inscribed before all time
Redeemed by love in grace divine
The heavens open, spirits sing
Creation bows before the King
We are rising, rising high
Lifted up beyond the sky
Every tear now wiped away
As night gives birth to endless day
Together in the, the trumpet sound
In peace and glory we are found
No fear remains, no shadow stands
He holds us close within his hands
The truth proclaimed, the word alive
In him forever we shall rise
We are rising, rising high
Lifted up beyond the sky
The Eternals dawn, the saints rejoice
All praise lifted in one voice
The gathering of the trumpet sound
For whom at last forever crowns
We are found
